command:
if [ ! -f /mnt/opt/openFuyao/mindio/*.zip ]; then
  echo "/mnt/opt/openFuyao/mindio has no zip file"
  tag=$(sh /tmp/mindio/obtain-version.sh)
  sh /tmp/mindio/download.sh $tag
else
  echo "mindio.zip found, skipping install..."
  unzip "/mnt/opt/openFuyao/mindio/*.zip" -d /tmp/mindio/
fi
sh /tmp/mindio/entrypoint.sh acp;
while true; do
  sleep 3600
done

nsenter -t 1 -i -m -n sh -c 'component="acp"; package=$(python3 -m pip list | grep -i $component | awk "{print $1}" | head -n 1); if [ -n "$package" ]; then python3 -m pip uninstall -y $package; fi; sleep 2; rm -rf /opt/openFuyao-npu-mindioacp;'

containers.name: acp-container

args: exec python3 /app/k8s_proxy_server_example.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --prefiller-labels app=prefill --decoder-labels app=decode --prefiller-container prefill-engine --decoder-container decode-engine --prefiller-port-name prefill-port --decoder-port-name decode-port --namespace liangjiahao
containers.name: proxy-server

args: useradd hwMindX; groupadd hwMindX; usermod -aG hwMindX hwMindX; chown hwMindX:hwMindX /var/log/mindx-dl/clusterd; chmod 750 /var/log/mindx-dl/clusterd; /usr/local/bin/clusterd -logFile=/var/log/mindx-dl/clusterd/clusterd.log -logLevel=0
containers.name: clusterd

command:
if [ ! -f "/etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml" ]; then
    echo "kube-apiserver.yaml not found in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml"
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f "/etc/kubernetes/pki/front-proxy-ca.crt" ] && ! kubectl get secret front-proxy-ca-cert -n kube-system 2>/dev/null 1>/dev/null; then
    kubectl create secret generic front-proxy-ca-cert                               --from-file=front-proxy-ca.crt=/etc/kubernetes/pki/front-proxy-ca.crt                               --namespace="kube-system"
fi

echo "Start installing yq"
chmod +x /home/openfuyao-system/amd64-bin/yq_linux_amd64
chmod +x /home/openfuyao-system/arm64-bin/yq_linux_arm64
/home/openfuyao-system/arm64-bin/yq_linux_arm64 -h > /etc/kubernetes/yq_linux_arm64.log 2>&1
if grep -q "syntax error" /etc/kubernetes/yq_linux_arm64.log; then
    echo "use yq_linux_amd64"
    mv -f /home/openfuyao-system/amd64-bin/yq_linux_amd64 /usr/local/bin/yq
else
    echo "use yq_linux_arm64"
    mv -f /home/openfuyao-system/arm64-bin/yq_linux_arm64 /usr/local/bin/yq
fi
echo "yq installed"

echo "write cert to webhook directory"
mkdir -p "/etc/kubernetes/webhook"
kubectl get configmap oauth-webhook-config-yaml -n openfuyao-system-controller -o jsonpath='{.data.webhook-config\.yaml}' > /etc/kubernetes/webhook/webhook-config.yaml
kubectl get secret "oauth-webhook-tls" -n openfuyao-system-controller -o yaml | yq eval '.data."ca.crt"' | base64 -d > "/etc/kubernetes/webhook/ca.pem"
kubectl get secret "oauth-webhook-tls" -n openfuyao-system-controller -o yaml | yq eval '.data."tls.crt"' | base64 -d > "/etc/kubernetes/webhook/server.crt"
kubectl get secret "oauth-webhook-tls" -n openfuyao-system-controller -o yaml | yq eval '.data."tls.key"' | base64 -d > "/etc/kubernetes/webhook/server.key"
chmod 400 "/etc/kubernetes/webhook/ca.pem"
chmod 400 "/etc/kubernetes/webhook/server.crt"
chmod 400 "/etc/kubernetes/webhook/server.key"

echo "modify kube-apiserver.yaml"
if ! grep -q "authentication-token-webhook-config-file" /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml; then
    yq -i '.spec.containers[0].command += ["--authentication-token-webhook-config-file=/etc/webhook/webhook-config.yaml"]' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
    yq -i '.spec.containers[0].command += ["--authentication-token-webhook-cache-ttl=5m"]' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
    yq -i '.spec.containers[0].volumeMounts += [{"mountPath": "/etc/webhook", "name": "webhook-config", "readOnly": true}]' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
    yq -i '.spec.volumes += [{"hostPath": {"path": "/etc/kubernetes/webhook", "type": "DirectoryOrCreate"}, "name": "webhook-config"}]' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
fi
yq -i '.spec += {"dnsPolicy": "ClusterFirstWithHostNet"}' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
echo "Initialization complete"
containers.name: modify-manifests-m1

command:
echo "waiting for apiserver..."
until kubectl get cm -n openfuyao-system console-service-config > /dev/null 2>&1; do
  sleep 2
done
echo "apiserver is ready"
initContainers.name: check-apiserver
